services.name: By Cruise
services.desc: If you’re a seasoned cruiser, you know the options to see the world by water are endless. Whether it’s a Mediterranean cruise through the Greek Isles, a month-long tour from Beijing to Sydney or a relaxing Caribbean getaway through some of the earth’s most pristine waters, cruises offer a diversity that many travel experiences find hard to rival. Our talented travel designers will help you find the right match by researching, quite literally, a "Sea of Options." Clients can also rest easy by taking advantage of our special Pique Perks: Private car and driver in port. Behind-the-scenes tours. Specialty dining options. Shipboard and spa treatment credits. Custom and private shore tours.

services.name: By Bike
services.desc: Experience a destination up close and personal as you wind through pristine valleys or cruise over cobblestone streets. Wine and culture tours through Europe, adventure biking throughout the National Parks, and off the beaten path biking throughout Southeast Asia are just a few examples of the unique experiences this type of travel has to offer. Our talented travel designers will help you find the right match by comparing differing biking tour options. Clients can also rest easy by taking advantage of our special Pique Perks: Assistance with all aspects of your travel including flights, hotels, and transfers. blurb: Pique Travel Design offers custom-designed trips, cruises, group escorted tours, lodging at boutique properties, and luxury train experiences. They provide expert travel advice based on first-hand knowledge and curate unique travel experiences tailored to the client. Their services include ocean, expedition, river, and private yacht cruises, as well as group tours with well-known operators.
